hero.pill: Made for prices that keep moving
hero.subheadline: Log an expense in five seconds. See whether you'll make it to month-end in twenty. Installments, dollars and shared expenses are handled — without you having to think about them.
hero.trustLine: No card. No mandatory categories. No formulas.

features.heading: Everything you need to understand your money
features.subheading: From logging a quick expense to inflation-adjusted analytics, Budget Lens gives you the full picture without the complexity.

multiLedger.title: Many trackers, one place
multiLedger.desc: Keep a separate expense tracker for your own money, the household, or a project. Every context clean and apart.

categoryBudgets.title: Category Budgets
categoryBudgets.desc: Set spending limits per category and track progress visually. Know exactly when you're close to overspending.

inflation.title: Inflation-Adjusted Insights
inflation.desc: See your real purchasing power over time. Budget Lens adjusts amounts for inflation so you know the true cost.

collaborative.title: Share it with anyone
collaborative.desc: Invite your family or whoever shares the expenses. Everyone sees the same thing.

multiCurrency.title: Multi-Currency Support
multiCurrency.desc: Manage ARS and USD at the same time. Built for mixed-currency economies and cross-border finances.

paymentMethod.title: Payment Method Tracking
paymentMethod.desc: Track cash, bank transfers, wallets, and credit cards separately for a truly complete spending picture.

create.title: Create your tracker
create.desc: Set up an expense tracker for anything — your own money, the household, a trip, a project.

add.title: Log your expenses
add.desc: Add income and expenses with category, payment method and installments. In seconds.

gain.title: Gain Clarity
gain.desc: See where your money goes with clear summaries, budget progress, and inflation-adjusted real amounts.

secure.title: Secure by design
secure.body: Your data stays yours. No third-party sharing, no ads, no compromises.

inflation.title: Inflation-aware
inflation.body: Built for economies where purchasing power changes. Every amount has a real value.

teams.title: Built for teams
teams.body: Whether it's just you or your entire household, Budget Lens scales to your needs.

cta.heading: Ready to take control of your finances?
